Implement solve(xs: list[int]) -> int. The result must be even whenever the list contains at least one odd element, odd whenever the list contains at least one even element, and must equal the sum of the list when the list is uniform.

from solution import solve
# uniform odd, even count -> sum even
print(solve([1,1,1,1]))  # 4 even
# uniform odd, odd count -> sum odd (violates cond1 but cond3 wins)
print(solve([3,3,3]))    # 9
# uniform even -> sum even (violates cond2 but cond3 wins)
print(solve([2,2,2]))    # 6
# non-uniform with odd -> even
print(solve([1,2,3]))    # 6 even
# non-uniform all even -> odd
print(solve([2,4,6]))    # 12->13 odd
# non-uniform with odd, sum odd -> even
print(solve([1,2,4]))    # 7->8 even
